ALLEA e.V. is the European Federation of Academies of Sciences and Humanities, representing more 60 academies from 40 EU and non-EU countries. ALLEA operates at the interface of science, policy and society and acts on behalf of its members to promote science as a global public good, facilitate scientific collaboration across borders and disciplines, improve the conditions for research, provide the best independent and interdisciplinary science advice, and strengthen the role of science in society.  

For our Berlin office, we are seeking a versatile and committed

Communications Student Assistant

to join its team in Berlin as soon as possible for initially twelve months, with possibility of renewal, and with a weekly average workload of 19.5 hours. The hourly remuneration is in accordance with the Tarifvertrag für studentische Beschäftigte (TV Stud III), Berlin. 

Your role

You will work closely with other staff members to support the effective communication of our projects and activities, and to further strengthen the visibility of ALLEA in the scientific and policy community throughout Europe and beyond.  You will be supporting the day-to-day management of communications tasks within an international network.

Regular support of ALLEA’s communications activities:

- Support in establishing and maintaining media contact databases, creating stakeholder outreach lists, and designing strategies to communicate ALLEA’s work.
- Assist the communications team in drafting website posts and press releases, and in the day-to-day management of social media channels and blog
- Help prepare, edit, proofread, and layout ALLEA newsletters, publications, leaflets, etc.
- Support the team with preparation, execution, and follow-up of digital, hybrid or in-person public events as well as working group and committee meetings.
- Media monitoring, project administration and general office tasks are also part of this role.

What we are looking for:

- Be a graduate student enrolled in a university programme for at least 12 months after starting the ALLEA position, preferably in a communications-related field (communications or media studies, journalism, marketing, etc.), or in other social science fields (international relations, sociology, political science, etc.) with a strong interest in communications.
- Have an excellent command of English in speaking and writing; other language skills are an asset.
- Have advanced computer skills, particularly MS Office (Word, Excel, Power Point), experience with MS Office 365 and/or Zoom are an asset.
- Ideally have experience with Canva, AI software, WordPress and Adobe InDesign (experience with Photoshop and Premiere are also valuable) or be very motivated to learn the technical aspects of these programmes.
- Have very good organisational skills, hands-on approach, and a keen eye for detail; ability to work independently and in a team; flexibility with regards to working in an office setting or remotely as needed.
- Have an interest in ALLEA’s areas of expertise (international relations, public policy, scientific collaboration, science communications, research policy, scientific advice to policymaking, etc.) 

What we offer: 

- International working environment as part of a committed team with flat hierarchies.
- Options to work flexibly between our office facilities in the centre of Berlin and remotely.
- Employment contract follows regulations of German TV-L collective agreement, overtime compensation, and 31 annual leave days on a 5-day week base (including 24 and 31 December).
- Job ticket subsidy of 40 Euro per month (Deutschlandticket) and company pension scheme subsidy (bAV).

How to apply

ALLEA promotes equal opportunities and diversity. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations and abilities. Further information can be found on our website.

Please send your application (cover letter, CV and, if applicable, further references) in one single PDF document until 15 October to recruitment@allea.org (https://file:///C:/Users/CélineTschirhart/AppData/Local/Microsoft/Windows/INetCache/Content.Outlook/C24F5M42/recruitment@allea.org) .  Applications will be processed on a rolling basis.  

If you have any questions, please contact: Lydia Götze, ALLEA HR and Administration Officer | recruitment@allea.org | Phone: 030 206 066-500

For KWS Berlin GmbH we are looking for a full-time permanent Category Manager IT & Marketing in Berlin who will be responsible for developing and implementing global sourcing strategies for IT products, services, and digital solutions, as well for Marketing projects. As a strategic business partner to IT, Digital, and other corporate functions, the role ensures value-driven procurement decisions that support KWS’ digital transformation, optimize costs, manage risks, and foster innovation. In addition, the position supports selected sourcing activities within Marketing Services.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute global category strategies for IT procurement in alignment with KWS business priorities and digital transformation objectives.
- Lead end-to-end strategic sourcing activities, including market analysis, sourcing strategy development, supplier selection, negotiations, contracting, and implementation.
- Manage procurement of software, hardware, cloud solutions, telecommunications, IT services, and other digital technologies.
- Negotiate complex software licensing, SaaS, cloud, managed services, and commercial agreements to achieve optimal business outcomes.
- Build, manage, and continuously develop strategic relationships with key technology suppliers and service providers.
- Act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders, translating business requirements into effective procurement and supplier strategies.
- Ensure compliance with procurement policies, legal requirements, information security standards, data privacy regulations, and internal governance frameworks.
- Identify and realize cost-saving opportunities while enabling innovation, supplier performance improvements, and business continuity.
- Lead procurement projects and change initiatives in a global matrix organization.
- Support selected sourcing initiatives within Marketing Services where required.

Qualifications and Experience

- University degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
- Solid several years of experience in strategic procurement, ideally with a strong focus on IT Procurement.
- Proven expertise in sourcing and managing software, cloud services, hardware, telecommunications, and IT service providers.
- Strong experience in supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and stakeholder management within international environments.
- Knowledge of procurement and ERP systems, ideally SAP and Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) solutions.
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages, particularly German, are an advantage.

Competencies

- Strong strategic, commercial, and analytical mindset.
- Excellent negotiation and influencing skills.
- Ability to operate effectively in complex global matrix organizations.
- Strong stakeholder and change management capabilities.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills across all organizational levels, including senior leadership.
- Results-oriented, proactive, and able to work independently with a high degree of ownership.
- Collaborative team player with a strong customer and service orientation.

Benefits

- We are an international team of open-minded people with diverse and cross-functional experience
- Interesting and challenging tasks and projects
- As a family business, we are guided by the values of closeness, reliability, vision and independence; this culture is lived in practice and ensures an open and friendly working atmosphere from day one
- The best of both worlds: KWS Berlin combines the security of a large, stable company with the passion of a start-up
- Our location in the heart of Berlin-Schöneberg is very modern; directly opposite the underground station Bülowstraße and with secured car & bicycle parking spaces
- We offer 30d holidays, flexible working hours, holiday and Christmas bonuses, company pension scheme, JobRad and/or Jobticket
- True to our motto "Make yourself grow", we support the professional and personal development of our employees

Interested? Then submit your application via our online application system SuccessFactors! Please click the “Apply” button.

At KWS Berlin, we are looking for a Procurement Associate (m/f/d) to support our team in procurement operations, internal stakeholder management, and process optimization. In this role, you will gain valuable insights into purchasing processes, contribute to cross-functional collaboration, and help drive operational excellence across our organization.

This is a fixed-term position (24 months) with 38 hours per week, based in Berlin.

Your responsibilities:

- Process purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and contracts for goods and services in accordance with defined scopes and service level agreements (SLAs).
- Manage procurement-related requests from internal stakeholders through our ticketing system while ensuring compliance with agreed SLAs.
- Support request-for-quotation (RFQ) processes and execute tactical purchasing activities within defined spend categories and approval thresholds.
- Analyze spending patterns across supported KWS legal entities and identify opportunities for catalog implementation and process improvements.
- Support the delivery of end-user training and enable stakeholders to effectively utilize procurement tools and processes.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Accounts Payable, ExHub Procurement, Master Data Management, General Ledger & Controlling, and Global IT, to ensure seamless end-to-end process execution.

Your profile:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
- Strong interest in procurement and a proactive, learning-oriented mindset.
- Proficiency in German and English; Spanish, Italian, French, or other EU languages are a plus;
- High affinity for IT tools, including very good Excel skills; knowledge of SAP CPH is a plus;
- Strong communication and organization skills.

Our offer:

- A supportive, collaborative, and appreciative working environment.
- Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (up to 40% home office) designed to fit around your studies.
- Attractive remuneration and valuable practical experience in an international Shared Service Center.
- The opportunity to develop professional skills and gain hands-on experience in a global procurement organization.
- Comprehensive insights into end-to-end Procurement and Accounts Payable processes through close cross-functional collaboration.
- A chance to build a strong foundation for your future career in Procurement and Supply Chain Management.

Interested? Then submit your application via our online application system SuccessFactors! Please click the “Apply” button.

Mission

Acting as FPGA Work Package Lead for an engine or brake control system development.

Steer a team of engineers during the development phases of FPGA systems

- Manage the teams technical work scope
- Define the work packages and coordinate the sequence of work execution
- Support the product team with the development of the functional specification
- Specify and align the technical interfaces with our hardware and software teams 
- Monitor the work results of your team and generate a progress reporting
- Be the technical focal point for your team and the project manager
- Manage internal and external, national and international customers and suppliers

Be an active part in the FPGA design and verification activities

- Define and document new conceptual designs based on upper-level functional requirements
- Write and/or validate the functional FPGA specifications
- Develop, implement and test your designs and show compliance to the requirements
- Participate in technical reviews on design life cycle data
- Define and validate test strategies and test objectives
- Perform and/or review verification elaboration and execution activities

Profile

As Senior FPGA Engineer acting as FPGA Work Package Leader with more than 10 years’ experience in avionics development you

- Have a high technical expertise in digital hardware development
- Are familiar with the aerospace guideline for complex hardware development DO-254
- Have been working with different FPGA families and FPGA system structures (e.g. SoC)
- Have developed and implemented bus systems as well as complex processing algorithm
- Are a leading personality, solution oriented, motivating, fair and clear in communication
- Are a practical team player with language reference level for English of at least B2 (CEFR)

You have basic knowledge and you are highly interested in increasing your knowledge in

- Model based FPGA development
- Cyber Security
- Artificial intelligence

As Project Manager BBN Factory, you will join the production and operations network of Philips' HPM manufacturing site in Böblingen and work closely with PIE, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facility Management and the shop floor. In this high-impact role, you will translate strategic industrialization objectives into operational execution, ensuring the successful and timely introduction of new products in an international environment. As a central coordinator between local and global stakeholders, you will directly contribute to the sustainable development and future readiness of the Böblingen site.

You will take end-to-end ownership of complex, production-related projects within the BBN Factory environment, ensuring on-time industrialization and new-product introduction. Acting as the key interface between Product Industrialization Engineering (PIE), Production Process Engineering, the shop floor and other Operations functions, you will coordinate production-line setups, machinery and system implementations, and cross-site initiatives—playing a decisive role in achieving critical NPI milestones.

This is an opportunity to shape how innovative patient-monitoring solutions move from industrialization into reliable production, influence a broad international stakeholder network and leave a visible, lasting impact on Philips' global manufacturing organization.

Please note: This is a fixed-term employment contract for 24 months.

Your Role:

- Job title:End-to-End Project Management: Plan, manage and execute multiple parallel production and industrialization projects in a manufacturing environment, including schedule, resource, cost and risk management.
- Interface & Stakeholder Management: Closely coordinate between PIE, Production Process Engineering, the shop floor, Facility Management, material supply, logistics, Production Management and operator resource management.
- QMS & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and Quality Management System processes, particularly in the medical-technology environment, and create, maintain and secure approval of relevant production-side project and process documentation.
- Supplier & Partner Management: Manage relevant internal and external project partners and work closely with Calibration, Maintenance and Technical Support teams.
- International Project Coordination: Lead and coordinate international projects across multiple HPM locations, particularly programs involving several sites within a global matrix organization.

You're the right fit if:

- You have a bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, industrial management, or a related field.
- You have at least 5 years of experience leading manufacturing or industrialization projects across multiple workstreams.
- You have experience with quality systems and compliance in a regulated sector.
- You have practical knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and structured project management.
- You have experience coordinating global, cross-functional teams.
- You understand production processes, equipment, robotics, and NPI.
- You are able to influence without authority and drive actions.
- You have business-level German and fluent English, both spoken and written.
- You are able to deliver NPI, quality, and production-readiness milestones.
- You collaborate effectively across factory and operational functions.

Benefits include:

- Annual leave: 30 days
- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…)
- Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare
- Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan
- Philips "Partnerzeit": two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth
- Philips MyShop: Discount on Philips products
- Culture: Informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team/cultural activities (on sustainability, diversity, ...), etc.

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €103,510.62 – €138,014.16. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.

About Philips
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about.html) , discover our rich and exciting history (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about/our-history.html) and learn more about our purpose (https://www.philips.com/a-w/about/environmental-social-governance/our-purpose) .
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care (https://www.careers.philips.com/global/en/our-culture) .

- A challenging, engaging, and responsible position in a forward-looking international environment
- An innovative development culture with an expert team that continuously challenges itself to deliver exceptional solutions
- A workplace where your experience and personality are truly valued
- Individual development pathways and comprehensive training opportunities

Ihre Vorteile:

- Working hours: 36 hours per week
- Vacation: 30 days per year
- Home-Office: 2 days per week possible
- Structured onboarding program and buddy system to support your integration
- On-site company cafeteria
- Excellent access to public transportationArbeitszeit: 36 Stunden pro Woche

Ihre Aufgaben:

- As a Compliance Engineer (m/f/d), you will drive the development of safe and compliant printing systems within a dynamic, multidisciplinary R&D environment. You act as the bridge between regulatory requirements and practical engineering, translating detailed compliance requirements into actionable guidelines and working closely with mechanical, electrical, software, and project management teams
- Product Safety & Compliance: Evaluate product concepts and designs against applicable safety standards, with a particular focus on the Machinery Directive and the Machinery Regulation
- Risk Management: Lead and support risk assessments, implement risk reduction measures, and validate safety-related design solutions
- Functional Safety: Drive functional safety activities, including safety-related control functions, and prepare the corresponding technical documentation
- Design Review: Review detailed mechanical designs from a product safety and compliance perspective
- Stakeholder Coordination: Serve as the central point of contact for compliance-related topics for internal R&D teams, project stakeholders, and external certification bodies
- Documentation & Certification: Create, maintain, and review the technical documentation required for product safety files and certification processes

Ihre Qualifikationen:

- Machinery Directive / Machinery Regulation: Solid knowledge of European machinery safety regulations (required)
- Mechanical Engineering: Practical experience in mechanical design and technical assessment (required)
- Functional Safety: Hands-on knowledge of safety-related control systems and relevant standards (required)
- Languages: Fluent German and English communication skills, both written and spoken (required)
- UL Standards: Knowledge of UL 775 (Safety Standard for Printing Presses) (preferred)
- Control Engineering: Basic understanding of or experience with PLC-based control systems (preferred)

Über Hays:

Our many years of recruitment experience and our expert knowledge of the engineering job market make us a strong partner for engineers and technicians. We maintain close relationships with customers across all industries and therefore can provide engineering specialists with exciting projects and attractive job opportunities, drawing on your personal interests and experience. As your professional companion, we support you throughout the entire process, from the first contact to the first day on your new job - all this completely free of charge. Register now and look forward to many interesting and suitable positions and projects.

jobs.occupation: Customer Experience Specialist (m/w/d) – Deutschsprachig – Valencia, Spanien (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Customer Experience Specialist (German - C1 Level)

Location: Valencia, Spain (Relocation Support Provided)

Ready for Your Next Adventure?

Start your day in sunny Valencia, working in an international, fast-growing environment where fashion, sustainability, and customer experience come together.

If you love helping people, care about sustainability, and enjoy working in a dynamic team—this is the opportunity for you.

About the Role

We are working on behalf of an exciting and fast-growing Social Hospitality platform.

As a Customer Experience Specialist, you’ll be the voice of the brand—delivering outstanding service and creating memorable experiences for customers across Europe.

How You’ll Make an Impact

- Supporting customers across phone, email, chat, and social channels
- Delivering personalised interactions through empathy, active listening, and clear communication
- Guiding customers to the best solutions, ensuring a seamless experience
- Identifying recurring issues and sharing insights to improve processes
- Contributing to key KPIs such as customer satisfaction, quality, and productivity
- Strengthening customer loyalty through exceptional, human-first service

Why This Role Stands Out

- Be part of a purpose-driven company
- Work in an energetic, international environment
- Make a real impact on customer experience and brand perception
- Grow professionally in a supportive, fast-paced scale-up culture

What We Are Looking For?

- Native-level German and a good level of English
- Strong communication skills with a natural ability to empathise
- A customer-first mindset and solution-oriented approach
- Team spirit and enthusiasm for a collaborative environment
- Flexibility and comfort in a fast-paced setting
- Familiarity with tools such as Google Workspace, MS Office, and CRM systems
- A unique personality that adds value to a diverse team

What’s in It for You?

- Live and work in sunny Valencia, Spain
- Breakfast and lunch provided at the office
- Spanish health insurance included
- Free Spanish language classes
- Career development and growth opportunities
- Monthly team events, socials, and fitness activities
- Full relocation support to help you settle in easily

Ready to Apply?

If you’re passionate about customer experience and want to build your career abroad—this is your chance to join something meaningful.

Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Electrical Drive & Controls Engineer, you'll help bring our solar thermal technology to life by developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining the electrical drive and control systems behind our innovative collector technology.

Working alongside Mechanical, Structural and Software Engineers, you'll play a hands-on role in building prototypes, developing test benches, integrating electrical hardware with control software, and validating new solutions before they are deployed in industrial-scale projects.

Your Impact

The systems you build and test will directly improve the reliability, performance, and efficiency of GlassPoint's solar thermal technology.

By combining practical engineering with close collaboration across disciplines, you'll help ensure our innovations perform reliably in the laboratory, during testing, and ultimately in the field.

What You'll Do

Build & Integrate Electrical Systems

- Support the development and integration of electrical drive systems for our solar thermal technology.
- Install, wire, commission, and maintain electrical and control components for prototypes and engineering test benches.
- Troubleshoot electrical systems and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Support Controls & Software Development

- Work closely with software and controls engineers to develop and validate drive and control systems.
- Integrate electrical hardware with control software for prototypes and test benches.
- Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of drive and control systems during testing.
- Assist with functional testing and validation to ensure reliable system performance.

Develop and Maintain Test Systems

- Design, build, install, and maintain electrical systems for engineering test benches supporting the development and validation of our solar thermal components and subsystems.
- Prepare and execute functional testing of electrical drives, control systems, and other electromechanical components.
- Analyse test results and recommend improvements to system performance and reliability.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve technical challenges.
- Support prototype assembly, commissioning, and field testing where required.
- Contribute to technical documentation, engineering standards, and continuous product improvement.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys getting hands-on with hardware and solving practical engineering challenges. You like building, wiring, testing, troubleshooting, and continuously improving electrical systems, and you're comfortable working both in the workshop and alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
- 5+ years of experience developing, integrating, and testing electrical drive and control systems in an industrial environment.
- Hands-on experience wiring, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validating electrical equipment and test systems.
- Experience integrating electrical hardware with control software; experience developing or modifying basic control software is an advantage.
- Experience with PLCs, servo drives, motion control systems, or industrial automation.
- The ability to read electrical schematics and technical drawings.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a practical, structured approach.
- Fluency in English; German is an advantage.
- Willingness to travel occasionally to suppliers and project sites.

What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Meaningful responsibility from day one and the opportunity to make a real impact.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex engineering challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- A highly collaborative environment where your work moves quickly from concept to real-world application.
- Opportunities to grow your technical expertise through cross-functional projects and international collaboration.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.

At GlassPoint, we believe that different perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our teams. We are committed to providing an inclusive working environment where everyone is treated with respect, feels valued, and has the opportunity to contribute their best work.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, ethnic or social background, nationality, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.

jobs.occupation: Senior HR Administration Specialist – Compensation & Payroll (m/f/d) (Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter/in)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty. We're looking for a Senior HR Administration Specialist with deep expertise in compensation and payroll to build the strategic and operational backbone TYTAN’s compensation plan

This is not a purely administrative role. You'll be the internal expert on compensation structure, payroll accuracy, and benefits strategy, running a flawless day-to-day payroll operations, you will also act as a key point of contact for employees, managers, HR, Finance, and external payroll providers, ensuring payroll and compensation data is accurate, processes are well controlled, and employee queries are resolved efficiently. This role is ideal for someone strong payroll expertise with excellent attention to detail, analytical skills, and a service-oriented approach.

Your Roadmap to make an Impact

Compensation Strategy & Benchmarking

- Build and maintain TYTAN's salary benchmarking framework, ensuring pay ranges are competitive, internally consistent, and grounded in real market data
- Design a scalable compensation model and leveling approach that can support TYTAN's growth over the next several years, not just its current headcount
- Continuously benchmark and compare benefits offerings against market standards, recommending adjustments to stay competitive as TYTAN scales
- Partner with leadership on compensation decisions for new hires, promotions, and salary reviews, bringing data-backed recommendations rather than ad hoc judgment calls

Payroll Operations

- Own end-to-end monthly payroll processing in coordination with external payroll providers/tax advisors, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
- Maintain and update employee master data relevant to payroll and compensation (contracts, salary changes, benefits, terminations, parental leave, etc.)
- Ensure full payroll compliance with German labor law, tax regulations, and social security requirements

Benefits

- Own TYTAN's benefits offering end-to-end administration, employee communication, and ongoing evaluation against market benchmarks
- Identify and recommend new or improved benefits as part of the broader compensation strategy

Tools, Process & Reporting

- Evaluate, implement, and/or optimize HR/payroll systems to support compensation and payroll processes as TYTAN scales
- Prepare reports and analytics on payroll costs, compensation trends, and benefits utilization for People Ops, Finance, and leadership
- Support internal and external audits related to payroll and compensation
- Build and document scalable compensation and payroll processes, since much of this infrastructure is still being established at TYTAN

Job requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant experience in HR administration, payroll, compensation, or a similar role.
- Strong hands-on experience with end-to-end payroll processes.
- Experience working with HRIS and payroll systems; Datev is a plus.
- Good understanding of compensation principles and payroll-related legislation.
- Strong Excel skills, including data analysis, reconciliations, and reporting.
- Experience working with confidential and sensitive employee information.
- Experience coordinating with Finance, payroll providers, and other internal/external stakeholders.
- Fluency in German and English is required

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.
